instruction: Download all the songs from my Spotify song library that I have liked.
notes: Single-app task (spotify). The library contents and liked-song set are modeled as static world facts (in-library, liked) that become usable only after the nullary knowledge flags library-shown and liked-shown are set by show_song_library / show_liked_songs (both must be paginated at runtime). download_song is only applicable to songs that are both in the library and liked, so the library-only and liked-only representative songs can never be downloaded, mirroring the evaluation's 'exactly the intersection' requirement. The actual number of songs to download is unknown up front; two representative intersection songs are modeled, and supervisor-complete-task takes the downloaded task records as (non-API) parameters so its precondition equals the task-specific goal conditions. Username comes from supervisor.show_profile (email), password from supervisor.show_account_passwords.
